numbering_face_basis: MEASURED, not asserted: every per-chapter count in this file equals the WEB side of web_mt_verse_check.json and the chapters where the two witnesses diverge (20, 21) carry the WEB figure, not the MT one. Declared under #e13 ruling R2 because this file previously carried a face and named none, which silently broke four separate adjacency computations in a consumer.
numbering_face_obligation_on_consumers: Any tool that does verse arithmetic from these counts MUST assert the face it expects rather than infer it. Adjacency near a divergent chapter computed on the wrong face is simply the wrong verse, and the consumer cannot detect it.
